entries.headline: RCH165 KC-135 Stratotanker sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Boeing KC-135 Stratotanker using call sign RCH165, registration 58-0030 and hex code AE04B9. The sighting was credited to TruthSeekr60.

entries.headline: U.S. cargo, surveillance and coded-radio activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple U.S. Air Force cargo and surveillance aircraft airborne over the continental United States, with 10 coded military radio broadcasts detected that day as tensions with Iran remained high.

entries.headline: U.S. transport aircraft activity over Europe reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne, including several over the North Sea and one over the Baltic, amid reports of Iranian naval activity and rising U.S.-Iran tensions.

entries.headline: Strike on Tolyattikauchuk plant report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Ukraine General Staff report that Ukrainian forces struck the Tolyattikauchuk plant in Tolyatti, Samara Oblast, and said two outlets had confirmed the report.

entries.headline: Philippine Air Force training accident report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Reuters report that four Philippine Air Force pilots were killed in a training accident and said two outlets had confirmed the report.

entries.headline: U.S. transport aircraft and Iran warning reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported five U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne simultaneously and said U.S. intelligence had warned of increased targeting of American personnel amid escalating Iranian rhetoric.

entries.headline: U.S. transport aircraft, bomber and coded-radio activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force transport aircraft and a bomber airborne, along with one coded radio broadcast heard in the previous hour amid Middle East tensions.

entries.headline: DNI warning on increased Iranian activity relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a contributor report that U.S. Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton warned Secretary of State Marco Rubio that Iran had substantially increased certain efforts. The visible post did not identify those efforts.

entries.headline: SAM410 C-40B departure reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported that a U.S. Air Force 89th Airlift Wing Boeing C-40B using call sign SAM410 and hex code AE0945 had departed Florida. The sighting was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: U.S. transport aircraft and coded-radio activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple large U.S. military transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States and elevated coded-radio traffic across three regions, including the Middle East.

entries.headline: IRGC footage of tanker targeting reported
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a contributor report that footage released by the IRGC Navy showed two very large crude carriers being targeted with light anti-ship cruise missiles.

entries.headline: E-6B Mercury sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Boeing E-6B Mercury with no call sign, hex code AE0416 and registration 164404. The sighting was credited to reagan0965.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: BACE business-jet arrivals and impact estimated
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 935 business-jet arrivals, 52% above a normal October week, and estimated that they represented about $13.5 million of BACE2026's roughly $50 million Las Vegas impact.

entries.headline: BACE departure surge reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 259 departures from four Las Vegas-area fields by 1:43 p.m. ET, compared with 116 arrivals, and shared a time-lapse covering 10:17 a.m. to 1:29 p.m. ET.

entries.headline: BACE departure and arrival counts shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 120 departures and 48 arrivals across four Las Vegas fields by 12:15 p.m. ET on Thursday during BACE2026, and shared a 30-times-speed replay.

entries.headline: BACE Thursday traffic comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported business-jet activity up 10% while overall Las Vegas valley traffic fell 3% on Thursday compared with Wednesday, and shared a whole-day scan.

entries.headline: Las Vegas field departure count reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 243 aircraft still on the ground across four Las Vegas fields at 10:16 a.m. ET Friday, with 61 already departed.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE peak-hour replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a 30-times-speed replay covering 28 minutes of Wednesday’s NBAA-BACE peak traffic across Harry Reid, Henderson, North Las Vegas and Boulder City, followed by a valley-wide view.

entries.headline: N871CB Boulder City arrival replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared the Wednesday NBAA-BACE arrival of Citation CJ2 N871CB into Boulder City, showing the approach at ten-times speed and the touchdown in real time.

entries.headline: Henderson NBAA-BACE business-jet traffic reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 81 business jets at Henderson on Wednesday during NBAA-BACE, compared with 172 at Harry Reid, highlighting overflow traffic handled by the valley’s reliever airfields.

entries.headline: Las Vegas NBAA-BACE traffic comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported Las Vegas business-jet activity up 13% on Wednesday during NBAA-BACE while overall traffic eased by about 5%, citing SkyGlass MCP data.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE departure surge reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 360 departures across four Las Vegas-area airfields by mid-afternoon Wednesday following NBAA-BACE, including 148 departures from Harry Reid International Airport.

entries.headline: N333QS North Las Vegas arrival replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a one-take replay of N333QS, a Phenom 300, flying from Van Nuys to North Las Vegas and continuing from the valley to touchdown and back.

entries.headline: Harry Reid ramp aircraft counts shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 38 aircraft on one Harry Reid ramp and 26 on another on Wednesday morning during NBAA-BACE, shown in four frames from the valley to the ramp.
